summary: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Brimley Road and on McNicoll Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Scarborough Community Council directed Transportation Services to conduct a review of safety and operational concerns for road users at the intersection of Brimley Road and McNicoll Avenue. This report provides an overview of the assessments undertaken by Transportation Services. Transportation Services is recommending an eastbound right turn on a red signal prohibition at Brimley Road and McNicoll Avenue, as well as other improvements to refresh/enhance the signs and pavement markings at the intersection.
decided: City Council on June 26 and 27, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit eastbound right turns on a red signal at all times at the intersection of Brimley Road and McNicoll Avenue.
